scope: GNK DINAMO Ltd. Group / GNK ASG Enterprise Digital Platform
safetyRules: No production deploy without explicit user approval
No DNS, Cloudflare route, secret or mail-sending changes in this branch
No destructive edits to existing production modules
All operational modules are represented as monitored systems, not replaced

modules.label: Campaign Mailer
modules.operatorAction: Monitor queue state, delivery batches, retry status and pause controls
modules.writePolicy: No mass send from control plane

modules.label: Mail Studio
modules.operatorAction: Monitor editor availability, template health and manual-send readiness

modules.label: Email Status
modules.operatorAction: Surface delivery status, bounce indicators and failed retries

modules.label: Media Center
modules.operatorAction: Track accreditation forms, newsroom links, public documents and media assets

modules.label: News / Publishing
modules.operatorAction: Track HR/EN publication queues, SEO metadata and sitemap coverage

modules.label: Deployment / Recovery
modules.operatorAction: Show branch, build, rollback and recovery state
modules.writePolicy: No deploy trigger from public UI

modules.label: Registry Center
modules.operatorAction: Track DZIV, EUIPO, WIPO, Colorado, court register and FINA deadlines

modules.label: SEO / Publishing Engine
modules.operatorAction: Check meta, canonical, hreflang, schema, OG, sitemap and internal links

modules.label: Mobile Admin
modules.operatorAction: Provide approval queue, status cards and executive sign-off state

controlPlane.name: Operator OS / Mission Control
controlPlane.principle: Observe, validate, route, approve and recover; do not silently execute high-risk actions.
controlPlane.publicDisclosure: Digital operations workers and AI roles are presented as Global Operations Center capabilities, not as misleading real-person employment claims.
